text:
sarah-finance: Hi @tom-ops and @maria-cs — CorpAcct (acct-768) has an overdue invoice RWI-2025-06 for $18,450 (due 2025-06-12). We're at Dunning Level 2 and haven't received payment or a confirmed plan. They previously asked for a partial payment but no confirmation received. Proposing a 3-month plan: $6,150/mo; waive late fee if signed by EOD Friday and first payment received. Any objections or other options?

tom-ops: Thanks Sarah. Contact is Julia (julia@corpacct.com, +1-415-555-0134). CS flagged a usage dispute — they say an embeddings job spiked costs. Ops has a ticket open.

maria-cs: FYI they uploaded PO#98765 but legal hasn't signed it yet. Customer says procurement will wire 50% today if we hold enforcement. They asked we pause escalation while PO is validated.

andrew-fp&a: Can we reconcile before making concession? If the dispute is valid we should credit; otherwise we risk precedent. Can eng-ml verify the spike numbers?

collections-bot: Automated notice delivered to julia@corpacct.com at 2025-06-14T14:03Z — Dunning Level 2. Invoice PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/RWI-2025-06

sarah-finance: Action items: (1) @emily-ml / @eng-ml please review spike id spike-2025-06-11 and confirm overage by EOD today; (2) @maria-cs confirm PO clearance and wire proof; (3) I'll draft the 3-month payment agreement and send terms. If no response by Fri EOD escalate to legal. I'll place account on billing-soft-hold (no new deployments) — not a full suspension. :clipboard:

tom-ops: pinging @emily-ml for the spike review.

emily-ml: Quick look — the run was a large batch retry loop that retried 3x, resulting in ~2.1x expected token usage. Suggest we credit 90% of the overage; the customer should cover 10% as operational cost. I'll attach brief logs to the ticket.

sarah-finance: Ok — if eng-ml will cover 90% credit for the disputed overage and customer wires 50% today, I'm ok with starting the 3-month plan and waiving the late fee contingent on signed agreement + wire confirmation. Maria, please get proof of wire and attach PO; I'll draft terms and send signature link.

maria-cs: Customer confirmed they'll wire 50% today and sign the plan. I'll upload proof and PO#98765 once received. Thank you all.

sarah-finance: Great — marking this as "pending payment plan" in billing dashboard. If wire proof doesn't arrive by EOD tomorrow we escalate to legal. Closing loop here for now.
